summary: Smith & Nephew plc filed Form 6-K disclosing a TR-1 notification from Cevian Capital II G.P. Limited, which increased its aggregate voting rights to 14.214414% as of August 7, 2026, up from 14.010786%. Cevian holds via Master Fund L.P. (13.014856%) and Co-Investment Series P L.P. (1.199558%) through nominee Aurora Nominees Limited and custodian UBS AG. No board recommendation, advisors, price, or premium were noted. This incremental stake build signals potential activist pressure for strategic or operational changes; watch for public demands or board engagement and possible escalation in coming months.
